name: Ostgosh Rider
body:
In some parts of the world a powerful bird creature called the ostgosh travels the lands in herds. The peoples of those lands see the potential in the ostgosh as a companion, beast of burden, and war-mount. The ostgosh rider is akin to a knight at heart riding their ostgosh into battle against their foes.

Alignment: Any

Hit Die: d8

Alternative Class: cavalier

Starting Wealth: 5d6 × 10 gp (average 175 gp.) In addition, each character begins play with an outfit worth 10 gp or less.

Class Skills

The class skills of the ostgosh rider (and the key ability for each skill) are Acrobatics (Dex), Bluff (Cha), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Disable Device (Int), Disguise (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Fly (Dex), Handle Animal (Cha), Heal (Wis), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (engineering) (Int), Knowledge (geography), (Int), Knowledge (local) (Int), Knowledge (nature) (Int), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha) Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Sleight of Hand (Dex), Stealth (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Skill Points Per Level: 6 + Intelligence Modifier

Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Class Features
1st	+0	+0	+2	+0	Ostgosh rider, ostgosh mount, brand, stunt
2nd	+1	+0	+3	+0	Brand ability, stunt
3rd	+2	+1	+3	+1	Wind in their hair
4th	+3	+1	+4	+1	Stunt, expert trainer
5th	+3	+1	+4	+1	Inspiring moves
6th	+4	+2	+5	+2	Stunt
7th	+5	+2	+5	+2	Molting
8th	+6/+1	+2	+6	+2	Brand ability, stunt
9th	+6/+1	+3	+6	+3	Improved inspiring moves
10th	+7/+2	+3	+7	+3	Molting, stunt
11th	+8/+3	+3	+7	+3	Mighty charge
12th	+9/+4	+4	+8	+4	Inspiring cheer, stunt
13th	+9/+4	+4	+8	+4	Molting
14th	+10/+5	+4	+9	+4	Greater inspiring moves, stunt
15th	+11/+6/+1	+5	+9	+5	Brand ability
16th	+12/+7/+2	+5	+10	+5	Molting, stunt
17th	+12/+7/+2	+5	+10	+5	Reckless rider
18th	+13/+8/+3	+6	+11	+6	Stunt
19th	+14/+9/+4	+6	+11	+6	Molting
20th	+15/+10/+5	+6	+12	+6	Golden ostgosh
Class Features
Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

An ostgosh rider is proficient in all simple and martial weapons, as well as light armor and shields ( but not tower shields.)

Ostgosh Rider

An ostgosh rider gains the Ostgosh Rider and Mounted Combat feats as bonus feats. Additionally, they gain a +2 bonus to Ride checks made in regards to their bonded ostgosh mount.

Ostgosh Mount (Ex)

At 1st level, an ostgosh rider gains a bonded ostgosh to serve as their mount. The statistics for a bonded ostgosh can be found after this class’ description, but otherwise functions as a druid’s animal companion, using the ostgosh rider’s level as their druid level.

An ostgosh rider does not take an armor check penalty on Ride checks while riding their mount. The mount is always considered combat trained and begins play with Light Armor Proficiency as a bonus feat. An ostgosh rider’s mount does not gain the share spells ability, though is considered to have it for the purposes of gaining archetypes.

An ostgosh rider’s bond with their mount is strong, with the pair learning to anticipate each other’s moods and moves. Should an ostgosh rider’s mount die, the ostgosh rider may find another mount to serve them after 1 week of mourning. This new mount does not gain the link, evasion, devotion, or improved evasion special abilities until the next time the ostgosh rider gains a level.

Brand (Ex)

It is rare to find an ostgosh rider who rides alone. Most team up under some kind of form of unity.

Depending on your ostgosh rider’s character or setting, they may be a member of an order of knights, a racing team, or even an ostgosh gang.

At 1st level, an ostgosh rider must select a brand. This ability functions identically to the cavalier’s order ability, and may choose any order available to a cavalier or samurai.

An ostgosh rider’s brand grants them a number of bonuses, class skills, and special abilities. In addition, each brand includes a number of edicts that the ostgosh rider must follow. If they violate any of these edicts, they lose the benefits from their brand’s challenge ability for 24 hours. The violation of an edict is subject to GM interpretation. An ostgosh rider cannot change their brand without undertaking a lengthy process to dedicate themselves to a new cause. When this choice is made, they immediately loses all of the benefits from their old brand. They must then follow the edicts of their new brand for one entire level without gaining any benefits from that brand. Once accomplished, they gain all of the bonuses from their new brand. Note that the names of these brands might vary depending upon the campaign setting or GM’s preference. If an ostgosh rider already possesses a class skill granted by their brand, they gain a +2 bonus to that skill instead.

Stunt

Ostgosh riders are known for their incredible skill on the back of an ostgosh, their cunning personalities, and their flair for the dramatic. Every ostgosh rider is different, as is their relationship with their ostgosh. At 1st level, 2nd level, and every 2 levels thereafter ( fourth level, sixth level, eight level, etc.) an ostgosh rider selects and gains the benefits of a single stunt. They must meet the prerequisites of any stunt taken.

For a list of stunts see here.

Wind in Their Hair (Ex)

At 3rd level, an ostgosh rider gains a knack for knowing when the action will begin, and how to properly react to it. They gain a +2 bonus to initiative checks, and a +2 bonus to Ride checks and on acrobatics checks made when riding their bonded ostgosh.

Expert Trainer (Ex)

At 5th level, an ostgosh rider learns to train mounts with speed and unsurpassed expertise. The ostgosh rider receives a bonus equal to 1/2 their class level whenever they use Handle Animal on an animal that serves as a mount. In addition, they can reduce the time needed to teach a mount a new trick or train a mount for a general purpose to 1 day per 1 week required by increasing the DC by +5. They can also train more than one mount at once, although each mount after the first adds +2 to the DC.

Inspiring Moves (Ex)

At 5th level, an ostgosh rider’s presence and flair for the dramatic becomes a point of pride and inspiration to their allies and companions. As long as the ostgosh rider is clearly visible and has made either a combat maneuver check or a skill check within the past round, all allies within 60 feet receive a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear and a +1 morale bonus on damage rolls. At 10th level, and every five levels thereafter, these bonuses increase by +1.

Molting (Su)

An ostgosh rider knows how to bring out the best in it’s bound ostgosh, unlocking it’s hidden potential. As the ostgosh rider’s bound ostgosh goes through a process of molting, it gains new colors in it’s feathers, which are the tell-tale signs of hidden and deeper potential. At 7th level, and every three levels thereafter, an ostgosh rider may select one feather option, which adds a new ability to their bonded ostgosh. An ostgosh can only have one set of feathers active and molts to new feathers when taking an 8 hour rest.

White Feathers: The ostgosh may release a cloud of white down as a standard action, healing all allies within 20 feet of it by a number of d6s equal to it’s Constitution modifier. It may use this ability a number of times per day equal to it’s Constitution modifier. This ability is treated as channel energy for prerequisite purposes.
Green Feathers: The ostgosh may release a cloud of down as a standard action, allowing for all allies within 20 feet of it under an effect that can be ended by a saving throw to make an additional saving throw against one effect it’s suffering from. The ally makes this saving throw with either a +2 bonus or with the bonded ostgosh’ saving throw modifier, whichever is higher. The bonded ostgosh may use this ability an amount of times per day equal to it’s Constitution modifier.
Silver Feathers: The ostgosh may, as a standard action, release a cloud of down that grants all allies within 20 feet of it DR 5/-, 10 temporary hit points, and a +2 resistance bonus to all saving throws for a number of rounds equal to it’s Constitution modifier. The bonded ostgosh may use this ability an amount of times per day equal to it’s Constitution modifier.
Brown Feathers: The ostgosh may, as a standard action, release a cloud of down that grants all allies within 20 feet of it 5 temporary hit points, fast healing 5, and a +2 dodge bonus to their Armor Class for a number of rounds equal to it’s Constitution modifier. The bonded ostgosh may use this ability an amount of times per day equal to it’s Constitution modifier.
Orange Feathers: The ostgosh has become well acquainted with freezing environments, and gains a +5 racial bonus to checks and saves made to resist cold temperatures. Additionally, the ostgosh gains a 40-foot climb speed.
Black Feathers: The ostgosh gains a 60-foot flying speed with good maneuverability. An ostgosh with black feathers does not take a penalty to it’s flying speed due to it’s size.
Blue Feathers: After spending plenty of time adapting to it, a blue-feathered ostgosh is well adapted to the waters. It gains a 40-foot swim speed, and the amphibious quality.
Red Feathers: The ostgosh has become well acquainted with volcanic environments, and gains a +5 racial bonus to checks and saves made to resist high temperatures. Additionally, the ostgosh gains a 40-foot burrow speed with its rider, and may choose whether or not to leave a tunnel behind it as it burrows. Elemental Feathers: Select one from acid, electricity, fire, or cold. The ostgosh gains the energy resistance 10 against the type of damage selected, this stacks with other energy resistance the bonded ostgosh has. Additionally, the bonded ostgosh may add 1d6 of the selected energy damage to each of their natural attacks. Finally, the ostgosh gains a breath attack, which deals a number of d6s equal to their Constitution modifier. The damage dealt is of the type selected and is either a 15 foot cone or a 30 foot line, chosen when the feathers are chosen. A creature caught in this breath attack may make a Reflex saving throw (DC of 10 + the bonded ostgosh’s Constitution score +1/2 their HD. The bonded ostgosh may use this breath attack a number of times per day equal to it’s Constitution modifier.
Stinky Feathers: While most ostgosh riders train and treat their mounts to keep them fresh, some learn to control the unpleasant smell of their mounts. As a standard action, this ostgosh may gain the Stench ability for a number of rounds equal to it’s Constitution modifier. A creature effected by this ostgosh’s stench is sickened for 3 rounds. The ostgosh may use this ability a number of times a day equal to it’s Constitution modifier.
Improved Inspiring Words (Ex)

At 9th level, in addition to it’s normal benefits, an ostgosh rider’s inspiring moves ability grants a +2 morale bonus on saving throws against charms and compulsions. Additionally, when an ostgosh rider succeeds on a skill check or combat maneuver in combat, they can perform a showy move or trick as an immediate action. Performing a backflip on their bonded mount, having their bonded mount run in a donut-like shape, or posing dramatically are a few options. All allies who can see or hear this trick gain an additional saving throw against any one spell or effect that is currently affecting them. This save is made at the original DC. Spells and effects that do not allow for saving throws are not affected by this ability. An ally cannot benefit from this ability more than once per day.

Mighty Charge (Ex)

At 11th level, an ostgosh rider learns to make devastating charge attacks while mounted. Double the threat range of any weapons wielded during a charge while mounted. This increase does not stack with other effects that increase the threat range of the weapon. In addition, the ostgosh rider can make a free bull rush, disarm, sunder, or trip combat maneuver if their charge attack is successful. This free combat maneuver does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

Inspiring Cheer (Ex)

At 12th level, an ostgosh rider can cheer on an ally who can hear them as a standard action. That ally can instantly take a single move or standard action. Taking the action dazes the ally for 1 round afterward. At 20th level, the ostgosh rider can use this ability as a move action, but no more than once per round.

Greater Inspiring Moves (Ex)

At 14th level, an ostgosh rider knows how to fortify their allies’ resolve in combat. Whenever an ostgosh rider performs the trick granted to them by their improved inspiring moves ability, they may also grant any ally who can see or hear the trick a number of temporary hit points equal to their Charisma modifier. These temporary hit points do not stack with themselves, but do stack with temporary hit points from other sources. Additionally, they may now perform such tricks as a free action.

Reckless Rider (Ex)

At 17th level, an ostgosh rider and their mount can make a tactical rush through enemy ranks as a full-round action. Their mount can move up to twice its normal speed in a straight line. The ostgosh rider can make a single attack against each creature they threatens during their mount’s movement, up to their normal number of attacks per round. These attacks use their full base attack bonus and take a –2 penalty. These attacks are treated as being part of a charge. The ostgosh rider provokes attacks of opportunity during this movement, but their mount does not.

Golden Ostgosh (Ex)

At 20th level, after aiding their bonded ostgosh mount through many cycles of molting, their ostgosh finally grows golden plumage. As a move action, an ostgosh rider may choose to lose the benefits from their chosen molting feathers in favor of gaining the benefits of another, including a set of feathers that they do not normally have access to. This change lasts for one minute. An ostgosh rider may use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + their Charisma modifier.
